[[File:Tapani_nobility.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Tapani nobility]]
The '''Tapani [[Noble/Legends|Noble]] Houses''' were the ruling families of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. When the sector was first colonized, there were twelve houses. Two were destroyed in the [[Unification War|civil war]] [[Shey Tapani]] initiated, while [[House Nidantha|another]] seemingly collapsed on itself shortly there after. Two others were believed to be destroyed during the [[Cleansing of the Nine Houses]]. Competition between the houses was fierce, and there were several civil wars. All noble families in the sector were members of a particular house, during the [[Rebellion era]] there were seven of these coalitions of families that ruled the provinces of the sector. Of these seven, houses [[House Mecetti|Mecetti]], [[House Cadriaan|Cadriaan]] and [[House Melantha|Melantha]] were the most powerful during the [[Rebellion era|era]].

[[Wineth Lastemin|Lady Wineth Lastemin]], [[Agatha|Lady Agatha]], [[Hoall|Lord Hoall]], [[Balcomb|Baron Balcomb]],<ref name="PGtT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref> [[Bertrum|Baron Bertrum]] and [[Munsk|Baron Munsk]] were Tapani sector nobles during the [[Rebellion era]] but which house they belonged to is not known. Traditionally, Tapani nobles presented an [[ulikuo gemstone]] as part of a marriage proposal.

[[Leocald VII]] and [[Gorgano IV]] were [[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperors]] of the Tapani sector however their house affiliation is unknown.<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

Baron [[Karoll Cilarnus]] was possibly a Tapani noble of unknown house allegiance. He was responsible for the manufacture of the starship that would later be known as the ''[[Moomo Williwaw]]''.<ref name="KotORH">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref>

[[Andra (captain)|Captain Andra's]] family had a very ancient lineage and once belonged to a noble house that was disbanded when the [[Freeworlds Territory|Freeworlds]] ceded from the [[Expanse]].<ref name="LotE" />
